# Vendored frontend files

No internet is required when a page is viewed. Each file was downloaded once
from the source URL at vendor time; `sha256` is of the file as stored here.

| File | Version | Source URL | sha256 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `htmx.min.js` | htmx 4.0.0 | https://unpkg.com/htmx.org@4.0.0/dist/htmx.min.js | `e484d9171a9db30a39c8f16e3d709d4137f3211c659f8e6125816635033d593f` |
| `pico.min.css` | Pico CSS 2.1.1 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@picocss/pico@2.1.1/css/pico.min.css | `fbc9a63fc9fc9f72d12fd7fc9806e11fa9f77ae4f9cad146b27003a1119ba3db` |

Both are referenced as `/static/vendor/htmx.min.js` and `/static/vendor/pico.min.css`.
The classless and colour-theme Pico variants are deliberately not used.
